scope: v0.7 six unrestricted equipment slots, purchase-ordered appearance, 17 monsters, two large five-level maps and following camera. Existing local networking/attributes preserved.

browserBeforeFinalNavigationOnlyFix.note: These production UI and Boss visual suites preceded only the player/monster navigation-radius fix. Unchanged UI was not redundantly rerun; final build reran normal progression, column navigation, controls, collision and multiplayer recovery.

benchmark.scope: Headless logic/snapshot performance before final navigation-only fix; not rendering FPS or network capacity.

ember and frost Boss telegraphs and silhouettes

compatibility.legacyData: Old v1/v2 checkpoints and old developer presets are not silently migrated.

boundaries: 17 monsters use procedural low-detail runtime art and animation, not 17 newly generated sprite sheets.
10 existing equipment definitions migrated; 8 additional designed items and their new passives remain future EQ-02 work.
Normal campaign bot can read snapshots and dodge warnings; completion is not a human difficulty/balance study.
